content.value_statement: Complex coding tasks can lose context across analysis, design, implementation, review, and delivery. This skill defines a staged Claude and Copilot workflow with clear outputs.
actual_capabilities: Defines analyze, design, implement, review, and deliver stages for AI-assisted development.
Provides slash command patterns for each workflow stage.
Documents expected outputs, including reports, source changes, and delivery materials.
Assigns Claude and Copilot responsibilities for implementation, design, and review.
Explains workflow state recovery after an interrupted run.
limitations: The audited package contains only SKILL.md, not command implementation files.
Full use depends on Copilot MCP availability and configured Claude tooling.
It does not validate generated code or run tests by itself.
Human review is still required before production release.

use_cases.title: Plan a Feature Build
use_cases.description: Break a new feature into analysis, design, implementation, review, and delivery stages with named outputs.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Architecture Review
use_cases.description: Use Copilot for design recommendations while Claude tracks requirements, implementation tasks, and final documentation.

use_cases.title: Manage Solo Delivery
use_cases.description: Keep a small project moving through structured checkpoints without losing context between model interactions.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Full Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use copilot-flow to plan and execute a five-stage workflow for a small user profile feature. Show the stage preview before starting.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Requirements
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the analysis stage for a billing settings change. Identify requirements, risks, open questions, and expected stage outputs.

prompt_templates.title: Review an Implementation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the review stage for completed authentication work. Focus on security, maintainability, tests, and release readiness.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Complex Delivery
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the full workflow for a multi-service API migration. Keep stage outputs traceable and prepare final delivery notes with decisions and remaining risks.

output_examples.input: Plan a complete workflow for adding JWT authentication to a REST API.
output: A requirements analysis checkpoint with risks and open questions.
A design stage for architecture decisions and implementation guidance.
A review and delivery stage covering quality, documentation, and release readiness.

output_examples.input: Review a completed feature before delivery.
output_examples.output: A review report summary covering security, maintainability, test coverage, and next actions.
Guidance to inspect the saved stage, continue from the last completed step, or restart a specific stage.

best_practices: Start with clear requirements and desired outputs.
Review each stage result before moving forward.
Use full workflow for complex changes and individual stages for focused tasks.
anti_patterns: Do not skip review when code changes affect security or data.
Do not treat stage reports as proof that tests passed.
Do not manually edit workflow state unless recovery requires it.

faq.question: Does this skill run Copilot directly?
faq.answer: It defines a workflow that expects Copilot MCP integration for design and review stages.

faq.question: Can I use only one stage?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill describes individual analyze, design, implement, review, and deliver stages.

faq.question: Does it include command implementation files?
faq.answer: This audited package only contains SKILL.md, so command implementations are not included in the reviewed files.

faq.question: What files does it expect to create?
faq.answer: It describes stage reports, source changes, a workflow state file, and a delivery package.

faq.question: Is it suitable for production code?
faq.answer: It can support production work, but human review and tests remain required before release.

faq.question: Which tools are supported?
faq.answer: The metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
